planned.title: Get Up

planned.title: Empty Pools

planned.question: Who taught you something you still use, and have you written their name down?

planned.title: The Pears
planned.question: What have you done only because someone was watching you do it?

planned.title: Take and Read
planned.question: What have you been slowly becoming that might arrive all at once?

planned.title: What, Then, Is Time?
planned.question: Where is yesterday, right now?

planned.title: Midway

planned.title: Odysseus in Hell

planned.title: Climbing Is Lighter
planned.question: What are you working off, and how will you know when a letter is gone?

planned.title: Feared, Not Hated
planned.question: Who has power over you, and what keeps it legitimate?

planned.title: Knowing How to See
planned.question: What have you looked at long enough to draw from memory?

planned.title: The Bottega
planned.question: Which part of your made thing is the angel, the part you did alone inside someone else's structure?

planned.title: The War of Everyone Against Everyone
planned.question: Why do you obey? Not why you should: why you actually do.

planned.title: Inside Leviathan
planned.question: What would you be like with no sword above you at all?

planned.question: Who owns what you made at work last week? Read the contract.

planned.title: This Land
planned.question: What question do you already argue about? That is probably your made thing.

planned.title: The Pin Factory
planned.question: What is your pin? Name the one small step you do that someone else depends on.

planned.title: The Invisible Hand Appears Once
planned.question: When did you last do the right thing for a stranger because an imagined observer was watching?

planned.question: What has your work narrowed in you, and what are you doing about it?

planned.title: Self-Evident
planned.question: What sentence in your own argument would survive a committee?

planned.title: Faction
planned.question: What system in your life assumes people will be good? What happens when they are not?

planned.title: Ambition Against Ambition
planned.question: Where in your work does a check feel like an obstacle? Is it doing its job?

planned.title: The Room Where Equals Argue
planned.question: What is the largest group you have seen actually change its mind? How big was it?

planned.title: The Earth Belongs to the Living
planned.question: If your argument became a rule tomorrow, who would it bind, and did you ask them?

planned.title: The Creature Reads
planned.question: What have you made that has since been used in a way you never intended? Did you go back for it?

planned.question: What is the thing you made and then walked away from, and what would it say to you if it could?

planned.title: Circuits That Live and Die
planned.question: What is the difference between an instrument and a creature? Where is the line, exactly?

planned.title: The Tangled Bank
planned.question: Look at one living thing today for ten minutes and ask: what made this, and did it mean to?

planned.question: What have you observed long enough, and written down carefully enough, to see it change?

planned.title: The Overwhelming Indifference
planned.question: If nothing out there is keeping score, what are you owed, and by whom?

planned.title: The Shift Change
planned.question: What machine sets the pace of your day, and did you choose it?

planned.title: The Working Day

planned.title: We Have Killed Him

planned.title: The Human Use of Human Beings

planned.title: The Machine Stops
planned.question: What have you not touched this week that you only saw on a screen?

planned.question: Which of your tools has gotten better by making you choose it?

planned.question: Did his forecast come true? One reason.

planned.question: What did the room say that you now believe?

planned.question: What have you made that gave one person power over another?

planned.title: The Builder's Bench
planned.question: Which of the five words is hardest to apply to your own work?

planned.title: The Petition
planned.question: If you signed a petition against your own project, what would its first sentence say?

planned.question: What number at your work does management not want to hear?

planned.title: The Phone Call
planned.question: What would you do the day you found your own fatal mistake?

planned.question: What has your code done to a person who never saw it?

planned.title: The Arsenal and the Scholar
planned.question: Who funds the field you are entering, and what do they want from it?

planned.title: The Strong Do What They Can
planned.question: Is there a project you would refuse even if someone else would build it anyway?

planned.title: Politics and the English Language
planned.question: What is the euphemism your industry uses for the harm it does?

planned.title: Unassisted: The Cold Case
planned.question: What did you decide — and on what principle?

planned.title: The Tribunal
planned.question: What did counsel for the other side say that you could not answer?

planned.title: The Hide Houses at La Playa
planned.question: Walk to the nearest piece of water today. What work is being done at it?

planned.title: Where the Frontier Ran Out
planned.question: Where is your frontier — the edge you go to in order to be tested?

planned.title: The Land of Little Rain
planned.question: Where does the water you drank today come from? Can you name the river?

planned.title: Migrant Mother
planned.question: Who picks what you eat — and where do they sleep?

planned.question: Could you tell the thing you are making in seventeen verses?

planned.question: What is the weather of your square mile at the hour you would set a crime?

planned.title: Down These Mean Streets
planned.question: Where in your work do the mean streets run — and what is your code?

planned.question: What is the one detail from your square mile that says everything without arguing?

planned.title: Holy Water
planned.question: What piece of infrastructure in your square mile do you love without knowing how it works?

planned.title: The Wave Speech
planned.question: What wave are you on, and where does it break?

planned.title: A Royal Sport
planned.question: What did you do this year that someone will call a sport in a hundred years?

planned.title: The Pump House
planned.question: What is the pump house of your square mile — where does the culture gather?

planned.question: Which of the four did you choose — and what did you borrow?

planned.title: Read It at the Water
planned.question: Who heard it — and what did the place do while you read?

planned.question: Which text from Year 1 is already in your capstone without your noticing?

planned.question: Which of Gibbon's four causes will take your capstone first?

planned.question: Which argument from Year 2 does your capstone contradict?

planned.title: The Bed Made From a Living Tree
planned.question: What did you make in four years that proves it was you?

planned.title: Past the Pillars
planned.question: Is your capstone a homecoming or a last voyage — and which did you intend?

planned.title: Round Three: How Soon It Is All Forgotten
planned.question: If your capstone is forgotten in twenty years, what did it still do?

planned.title: San Diego Has Risen Four Times
planned.question: Which San Diego is your capstone built for — and which one will it meet?

planned.title: The Whole Earth Is Their Sepulchre
planned.question: What is the one sentence the examiners should say about your capstone?

planned.title: Round Four: What a Life Is For
planned.question: What is your capstone's work — and did it do it well?

planned.question: What did you say that you had not planned to?

planned.title: The Colloquium
planned.question: What will you read next, with no one assigning it?

planned.title: The Closer You Get

planned.title: The Steepest Part of the Face

planned.title: The Buoy Is a Clock

planned.title: Half of What's Left

planned.title: The Glide

planned.title: The Motion Study

planned.title: Every Sound Is a Sum

planned.title: Stitch It Back Together

planned.title: The Odometer and the Speedometer

planned.title: Speed Up the Tape

planned.title: A Tone Times a Fade

planned.title: The Blank at Ten Stations

planned.title: Loud Is the Average of the Square

planned.title: Drawbars

planned.title: The Ear Is a Prism

planned.title: A Sound From First Principles

planned.title: The Wave Is a Lecture

planned.question: Notice one thing today that kept going after the push ended, and ask what finally stopped it.

planned.title: What Comes Back

planned.title: The Rail That Holds

planned.title: Lean Angle
planned.question: Go around any corner and ask: what is pushing me toward the center, and how hard?

planned.title: Pumping
planned.question: Find one thing today that gained speed and ask where the energy came from.

planned.title: Two Boards in the Lineup
planned.question: Watch one collision today and ask where the motion went.

planned.title: Where You Carry It
planned.question: Stand on one foot and ask where your mass is and what you did to put it there.

planned.title: The Maneuver

planned.question: Next time you see waves, ask: where did this energy come from, and what shaped it on the way?

planned.title: The Machine Is the Wave

planned.title: The Long Ones Arrive First
planned.question: Look at any arrival today and ask what sorted it on the way.

planned.title: Sets and Lulls

planned.title: The Bend at Point Loma
planned.question: Watch any line of waves meet a shallow and ask which end slowed first.

planned.title: Standing Up and Falling Over
planned.question: Watch one wave break today and ask where it first felt the bottom.

planned.title: Rooms That Hum
planned.question: Find one thing today that rings at one note and ask why that note.

planned.title: Hot Sand, Cold Water
planned.question: Touch two things in the same sun today and ask why one is hotter.

planned.title: Why It Lifts at Eleven
planned.question: Watch the sky clear today and ask where the fog went.

planned.title: The Engine Called the Sea Breeze
planned.question: Find one thing today that ran because something hot was next to something cold.

planned.title: Ears at Twenty Feet
planned.question: Float something today and ask how much of it is under.

planned.title: The Rip Is a Pipe
planned.question: Watch water forced through a narrow place today and ask where it speeds up.

planned.title: Why Fins Hold

planned.question: Pour water over two surfaces today and ask which one it clings to.

planned.title: The Board on the Rack
planned.question: What did the water teach you that the sheet did not?

planned.title: A Photograph Is a Spreadsheet
planned.question: Look at one photograph today and ask: how many numbers is it?

planned.title: Arrows and Pixels
planned.question: Find one thing today that is really two or three numbers moving together.

planned.title: Any Color From Three
planned.question: Find three things today that make everything else of their kind by mixing.

planned.title: Brightness Is a Dot Product
planned.question: Find a shadow today and ask how much of the thing it kept.

planned.title: The Transform Tool

planned.title: Order Matters
planned.question: Reorder two steps of anything you do today and ask what changed.

planned.question: Find one target today you hit by adjusting three things, and ask whether there was only one way.

planned.title: How Much Did It Stretch
planned.question: Find one change today that lost something you could not get back, and ask what.

planned.title: Flatten
planned.question: Find one picture today and ask what direction it threw away.

planned.question: Find one thing you did today that you could undo, and one you could not, and ask what the difference was.

planned.title: Mid and Side

planned.title: The Directions That Stay Put
planned.question: Find one thing today that, pushed, stays pointing the same way.

planned.title: Keep the Big Ones
planned.question: Find one thing today you summarized with a few numbers and ask what you dropped.

planned.title: The Layer
planned.question: Look at one thing a model did today and ask which matrix did it.

planned.title: Built by Hand, Found in the Model
planned.question: What did the model learn that you had to be taught?

planned.title: The Ox at the Fair
planned.question: Say one thing you believe will happen this week, with a number for how sure. Write it down.

planned.title: The Problem of Points
planned.question: Count the ways one thing in your day could have gone, and ask how many of them were good.

planned.title: What You've Seen Changes What's Left
planned.question: Find one case today where learning something changed the odds of something else.

planned.title: The Buoy Says
planned.question: Take one belief you hold today and ask: what evidence would move it, and by how much?

planned.title: Pot Odds
planned.question: Price one choice you make today as a bet: the cost, the payoff, the odds.

planned.title: The One-in-a-Hundred Wave
planned.question: Count waves for ten minutes today, or sets, and ask which number you would report.

planned.title: The Bell on the Board
planned.question: Find one thing today that is a sum of many small chances and ask whether it should be bell-shaped.

planned.title: Did It Work

planned.title: The Score
planned.question: Look back at the number you wrote down on Day 1 and ask whether you deserved it.

planned.title: Scored in Public
planned.question: What were you most wrong about, and what did it cost?

planned.question: What do you know only because you keep telling yourself?
